digest.component_or_area: code-review impact-model decision logic and verification
propositions: The impact-code serious-maint lane must never dampen a SERIOUS-tier finding based on churn frequency; the debt-lane churn amplifier is amplify-only [1.0, 1.5] with cold/new files (churn90=0) never discounting.

Unversioned-public-contract-break must be classified SERIOUS only when a removal lacks a version-deprecation signal (major bump, deprecation cycle, or CHANGELOG breaking-change entry); managed removals with any such signal are FALSE and do not trip the boost.

Deleted public symbols reachable from the public API (__all__/re-export, CLI commands, MCP tools) must receive a 0.9 serious-tier impact boost when removal lacks version-signal present, keyed on the EXPORT name not on cited callers.

Impact-model version must be bumped from code-v4 to code-v5 to segment sidecar semantics, with new CodeSeverityAttrs booleans removed_public_symbol and version_signal_present (both defaulting False for abstain-safety).
Eval-spec must gain one fire case (unmanaged removal of exported public symbol) and one no-fire case (managed removal with deprecation cycle and CHANGELOG entry) for offline validation.

The 0.30 deletion-impact score on the citric-preregal-ladybird case (removed rebar.llm.review_ticket API) must reach ≥0.60 by applying the removed-public-symbol boost through the real packaged impact routing.
